column1: # The game leaves punctuation in its own text node after a tag:
# 45 such sites in src/. Single characters, which we normally forbid as
# substrings - but the rule exists because an IDEOGRAPH is ambiguous (峰 =
# Peak/Feng). Punctuation is not: in English output 。 is always a period.
# They are also the shortest possible keys, so longest-first ordering puts
# them last in the alternation - they can only ever touch what is left over.
